Note
The following information is only applicable to Amazon S3 data sources.
Enabling and disabling data sources
770
Amazon OpenSearch Service
Developer Guide
For circumstances when you want to halt direct query usage for a data source, you can opt to
disable the data source. Disabling a data source will ﬁnish executing existing queries and halt all
new queries from being executed.
Accelerations setup to boost query performance such as skipping indexes, materialized views,
covering indexes will be set to manual once a data source is disabled. Once a data source is set to
active after being disabled, user queries will run as expected. Accelerations which were previously
setup and set to manual, will need to be manually conﬁgured to run on a schedule again.
